cohort: The cohort consisted of 46 pregnant women diagnosed with threatened preterm labor (TPL) and 47 healthy pregnant women, all matched for gestational age.
finding: Maternal serum oxidative stress biomarkers (TOS, TAS, OSI, SOD) are significantly increased in pregnancies with threatened preterm labor compared to healthy controls, but these biomarkers are not effective in predicting true preterm birth among TPL pregnancies.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at the time of diagnosis of threatened preterm labor.
gest_age: Participants were matched for gestational age, and the study focused on pregnancies with threatened preterm labor leading to preterm or term deliveries.
